Based on my observation of the video frames, I can see what appears to be an intermittent outward deviation (exotropia), particularly of one eye, despite the patient being asymptomatic. I will proceed with the following investigations:

1. Cover-uncover test
2. Alternate cover test with prism measurement
3. Full extraocular muscle movement assessment
4. Visual acuity testing (Snellen chart)
5. Slit-lamp anterior segment examination
6. Dilated fundoscopic examination
7. Thyroid function tests (TSH, free T4)
8. Acetylcholine receptor antibody levels
9. MRI of the brain and orbits
